name: elvish_archdruid_green_for_each_elf_you_control
notes: M7 mapper. Printed: 'Other Elf creatures you control get +1/+1. {T}: Add {G} for each Elf you control.' Seat 0 controls the Archdruid and two other Elves (1/1 each); seat 1 controls an Elf. The other Elves of seat 0 are 2/2, the Archdruid stays 2/2 and seat 1's Elf stays 1/1. Tapping the Archdruid adds {G}{G}{G}: three Elves (itself included), not seat 1's.
